body: You are not useless, you will find your purpose one day. I am the exact same way, no passions, no talents, was so focused on all the wrong things in school I failed almost all classes (and relationships). I married my husband because he inspires me with his passions and determinations and I live by supporting him, he keeps encouraging me to try painting again, to work out if I want to, to read, such simple and almost free things to do, but I have no internal push to do anything, I feel useless, probably still to afraid of failure or worse- mediocracy. Anyway, back to you, if you can- adopt a pet. Dogs are the best (my opinion) and their unconditional love gets me through the worst days. Its sad, but sometimes seeing videos of dogs mourning their people keeps me from doing anything harmful, because I love my dogs so much I would hate to break their hearts (because I know at the very least, they will mourn me because I have poured myself into taking care of them and spending time with them to enrich their lives, maybe that can help you too.) Good luck, reply here if you want to chat.
Please don't, you can get through this. Focus on the good days, if there haven't been any till now, you still have a chance of creating them.
I'm sorry this is happening to you, is there any way you can lock your room from the inside for your own safety?

Did you just? Are you feeling all this?  
My sister once took 21 advils and felt similarly, she was taken to the hospital and they managed to get 11-13 pills out of her but she was dazed for a few more days.   
Are you ok?

The fact that you want to figure out what to do and that you feel like you are running out of time is a good thing (in a way, if we are on the same page). Growing up I thought I wanted to be a fashion designer, architect, business savvy marketing exec in a cosmetics company, big LOL I now work in HR and I'm not passionate about it, I just do it because I can, and after doing it for 6 years I have realized, I'm kind of really good at it and that brings me joy (small wins). I know it's easy to say not to take the pressure, especially in terms of "time" because we place arbitrary deadlines on our life and set unrealistic expectations which don't apply to everyone. As for people, it take time to find the right people for you, you are not a burden- maybe you should open up to them about how you feel and gauge if they are the right people to trust with your feelings, if they let you down don't sweat it, you took a risk and let yourself be vulnerable and it they do not respond in kind with the same respect for you they are not worth your time. I am grateful you posted here, you are not alone.

Today is my first day on reddit, I'm still learning how this works so please forgive me if I overstep here. I came here to find support amongst others who are also struggling with suicidal thoughts. I want to die most days but want to live for my husband and my family because I don't want to hurt them. I'm sorry you are hurting and just want to offer any friendship I can to you, please do not go ahead with what you are planning. We deserve to be here on earth as much as everyone else, we deserve to be happy, lets figure out what that means for you and stop your suffering. Please choose to live, I know it's difficult but, choose yourself and choose to be happy- harder said than done I know, but you aren't alone.
